Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
The forecast starts exactly at the last actual point.
Show both bands; say the horizon in the title (“next 4 months”).
The forecast colour is always AI (dataviz/ai/accent), never a series colour.
Honesty
A forecast without its band looks like a promise. Never hide the bands to “simplify”.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Observed series continued by a model forecast with 80% and 95% confidence bands inside a Prediction zone.
Encoding
x ← time · y ← value · dash ← forecast · band ← [lo, hi] per level
Interaction
Hover tooltip with range; legend toggles bands.
Accessibility
Summary: “Forecast for November 82, likely between 71 and 93 (80%)”.
